jenna (People Ops): Heads-up 9— Priya handed in resignation at 09:03am. Final day 2026-04-18. We need to lock in equipment returns, finalize COBRA timing, confirm final pay + payout of accrued PTO, and coordinate access removal.

priya (Engineering): I	2m available to help with handoffs. I have a company MacBook Air (asset 4819), a company phone (iPhone 13, asset 4820), and a YubiKey. I can drop off or ship.

sam (IT): Thanks. Prefer shipping with prepaid label. Once we receive the devices we'll schedule secure wipe + MDM removal. Plan to revoke SSO and VPN the morning after wipe. Also need a list of service accounts or secrets Priya manages.

maria (Hiring Manager): We'll do knowledge transfer sessions: 1) 30m on active services with Lina on 4/14, 2) doc handoff by 4/15. I'll consolidate the PRs and runbook links.

priya (Engineering): I can ship on 4/16. Please send a label.

jenna (People Ops): Return address: Redwood HQ Returns, 123 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105. I'll email the prepaid UPS label and a packing checklist today.

mark (Facilities): If she wants to drop in person at SF office, mailroom accepts items M-F 9-4. Badge will be disabled on final day at 09:00 PT.

olivia (Finance): Final pay: included in 4/30 payroll run. PTO payout per handbook; we'll calculate hours and include in final. Benefits active through 2026-04-30. COBRA packet emailed within 14 days of termination, with options. Priya, confirm email preference.

priya (Engineering): Email is fine. Also curious about RSU cliff/vesting treatment?

jenna (People Ops): I'll put together an equity + benefits summary and loop Legal for any vesting specifics. Expect that today.

sam (IT): Offboarding checklist (IT): generate return label, receive & log assets, verify asset tags, perform secure wipe, remove from MDM, revoke SSO/VPN, rotate any service account credentials called out in handoff. Will update with tracking number when label used.

maria (Hiring Manager): Please make sure PRs are assigned and any CI jobs with scheduled runs are transferred. I'll audit scheduled cron jobs Priya owns.

offboard-bot: Offboarding ticket OFF-4390 created for user priya.

jenna (People Ops): Exit interview options: 4/20 or 4/21 afternoon. Priya, which works? We'll do a 30-min Zoom, optional.

priya (Engineering): 4/20 after 1pm PT works.

jenna (People Ops): Action owners: People Ops (jenna) 9— COBRA + equity note, schedule exit interview. IT (sam) 9— device label + wipe + deprovision. Facilities (mark) 9— badge disable + returns support. Finance (olivia) 9— final payroll & PTO calc. Hiring (maria) 9— knowledge transfer coordination. I'll update OFF-4390 as items close. :white_check_mark:

sam (IT): Tentative tracking number (will be confirmed): UPS 1Z888EE10123456789.

jenna (People Ops): Thanks everyone — tagging for visibility and follow-up in ticket OFF-4390.
